FORM 10-K SUMMARY 118 SIGNATURES 119 Part I ♦ Item 1 – Business PAR T I ITEM 1 – BUSINESS General Martin Marietta Materials, Inc. (the Company or Martin Marietta) is a leading natural resource-based building materials company. The Company supplies aggregates (crushed stone, sand and gravel) through its network of approximately 400 quarries, mines and distribution yards in 28 states, Canada and The Bahamas. In 2025, aggregates generated 88% of the Company’s total reportable segment gross profit. As of December 31, 2025, Martin Marietta also provides other building materials, namely, cement, ready mixed concrete, asphalt and paving services in targeted markets where the Company has a notable aggregates position. The Company’s heavy-side building materials are used in infrastructure, nonresidential and residential construction projects. Aggregates are also used in agricultural, utility and environmental applications and as railroad ballast. The aggregates, cement, ready mixed concrete, asphalt and paving operations are reported collectively as the “Building Materials business”. The Company also operates a Specialties business (formerly known as the Magnesia Specialties business) with production facilities located in Michigan, Ohio, Nevada, North Carolina, Indiana and Pennsylvania. The Specialties business produces high-purity natural and synthetic magnesia-based products, including magnesium sulfate, magnesium oxide and magnesium hydroxide, that are used in environmental, industrial, agricultural, construction, consumer and specialty applications. The Specialties business also produces dolomitic lime, which is sold primarily to external customers for use in steel production and soil stabilization, and is also used internally as a raw material input in synthetic magnesia production. Specialties’ products are shipped to customers domestically and worldwide. The Company was formed in 1993 as a North Carolina corporation to succeed the operations of the materials group of the organization that is now known as Lockheed Martin Corporation. An initial public offering of a portion of the Company’s common stock was completed in 1994, followed in 1996 by a tax-free exchange transaction resulting in all of the Company’s common stock becoming publicly traded. credit_strengths.text: Aggregates generate the overwhelming majority of segment gross profit, and the quarry network across many states, Canada and The Bahamas underpins pricing power and margin resilience. Operating margin sits well above the sector median, evidencing cost discipline and premium product mix through the cycle.

Operating cash flow covers capital spending comfortably, leaving substantial free cash flow after the quarry network's maintenance and growth investment. That internally generated liquidity funds acquisitions, land purchases and shareholder returns without straining the balance sheet.

key_risks.text: Construction demand is cyclical and tied to infrastructure, nonresidential and residential activity, so a downturn would pressure volumes and pricing. The disclosed risk profile flags sensitivity to construction cycles, and operating income already fell sharply year over year, showing earnings volatility despite the aggregates franchise.

Debt is almost entirely fixed-rate senior unsecured notes with a long weighted maturity, but a large tranche matures in the second year and the trade receivable facility is short-dated. Refinancing that concentration at higher rates would lift interest expense, and change-of-control provisions could force repurchase at a premium.

debt_servicing_capacity.text: Interest coverage remains comfortable and free cash flow to debt is in line with the sector median, so cash earnings cover fixed charges with headroom. Leverage sits above the sector median, however, and the indicative financial risk profile is intermediate, leaving limited cushion before the next threshold.

Liquidity is strong, with a current ratio well above the sector median and a cash balance that, while modest, supports near-term maturities. The maturity ladder is long-dated beyond the second year, so refinancing risk is manageable, though the trade receivable facility adds a short-term funding element.

overall_credit_view.text: Martin Marietta's aggregates-led franchise, strong margins and solid cash generation support an investment-grade-like credit profile. Leverage above the sector median and cyclical construction exposure temper the view, but the long-dated fixed-rate debt stack and ample liquidity provide resilience through a downturn.

Our forward view is that free cash flow will continue to fund capital spending, acquisitions and shareholder distributions, keeping leverage near current levels. A sustained earnings decline or debt-funded acquisition could push leverage toward the next threshold, while stronger cash flow would improve the profile.

credit_strengths.text: 骨料業務產生分部毛利絕大部分，而橫跨多個州、加拿大及巴哈馬的採石場網絡支撐定價能力及利潤率韌性。營運利潤率遠高於行業中位數，證明整個週期內的成本紀律及優質產品組合。
營運現金流輕鬆覆蓋資本開支，在採石場網絡的維護及增長投資後留下可觀的自由現金流。該內部產生的流動性為收購、土地購買及股東回報提供資金，而無需令資產負債表受壓。

key_risks.text: 建築需求具週期性，並與基建、非住宅及住宅活動掛鈎，因此經濟下行將對銷量及定價構成壓力。所披露的風險狀況顯示對建築週期的敏感度，而營運收入已按年大幅下降，顯示儘管擁有骨料業務優勢，盈利仍存在波動性。
債務幾乎全部為固定利率優先無抵押票據，加權到期期限較長，但有一大筆於第二年到期，而貿易應收款項融資則屬短期。以較高利率為該集中到期債務再融資將推高利息開支，而控制權變更條款可能迫使以溢價回購。

debt_servicing_capacity.text: 利息覆蓋率維持舒適，自由現金流對債務比率與行業中位數一致，因此現金盈利覆蓋固定費用並有緩衝。然而，槓桿高於行業中位數，而指示性財務風險狀況為中等，在下一門檻前留下的緩衝有限。
流動性強勁，流動比率遠高於行業中位數，而現金結餘雖屬適度，仍支持短期到期債務。到期階梯在第二年之後屬長期，因此再融資風險可控，儘管貿易應收款項融資增加了短期資金元素。

overall_credit_view.text: Martin Marietta以骨料為主導的業務優勢、強勁利潤率及穩健現金產生支持類投資級的信用狀況。槓桿高於行業中位數及建築週期性敞口削弱了該觀點，但長期固定利率債務結構及充裕流動性提供抵禦下行的韌性。
我們的前瞻觀點是自由現金流將繼續為資本開支、收購及股東分派提供資金，令槓桿維持在當前水平附近。盈利持續下滑或債務融資收購可能將槓桿推向下一門檻，而更強勁的現金流將改善該狀況。
